notes.title: Kamil's dad visits Banu and Kamil...
notes.content: Kamil's dad visits Banu and Kamil... This is the continuation of "Stay with Kamil, Pure Banu" route. The man comes from a village away from the city where Kamil and Banu lives. He's going to stay with Kamil and Banu for some time. In this route Kamil and Banu relationship is good and mostly it depends on Kamil how the story will turn out at the end. Banu is a good wife. She quit gym to stay at home to take care of the home and Kamil as Kamil opposed her going to gym so Banu got some extra weight in this route. Kamil's dad grew up and always lived in a rural place away from civilization. He's a tough man and his ideas of a marriage are outdated. So the question is that how Kamil will deal with his dad and Banu at the same time and how their relationship will turn out to be. Coming soon...
